title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) was identified in the xdg-desktop-portal packages used by Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2. The flaw allows unauthorized host file access via unvalidated FileChooser filenames through the D-Bus portal interfaces. Red Hat has issued an important security update to address this issue in xdg-desktop-portal version 1.12.4-1.el9_2.1. The vulnerability affects multiple architectures of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2, including x86_64, ppc64le, aarch64, and s390x. No public exploit or in-the-wild exploitation has been reported. The vendor advisory provides official patches and instructions for remediation.
